name: Kumagai Haruka
source:
Due to her funky personality she lacks self-confidence. 
She is a well-bred girl and is somewhat ignorant so sometimes shows a natural airhead behaviour. She is a closet pervert.
Recently she fell in love and decided to change her personality to be able to confess her feelings.
However she is worried because she dont want to be rejected and outcast.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1069766]Getchu[/url]]
